name: Austin Redwood
original_name: オースティン・レッドウッド
source:
Austin Redwood is a Marshal of the Imperial Army and Irena's uncle. With the Emperor struck down by illness, he seeks to uphold the Empire in his stead. He has long cared for Irena like a daughter, quietly working to support her.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/imperium/chara07.html]official website[/url]]
